ipabazooka 1.4.0 — install apps on your iPhone or iPad from Windows

NEW TO SIDELOADING?
  Open the app and click "? Help" at the top, next to Theme. It explains
  what sideloading is, how to get an app file (.ipa), and how to use the
  app step by step.
====================================================================

WHAT'S IN THIS FOLDER
  ipabazooka.exe   The whole app in one file. No installer needed.

PUT IT ON ANOTHER COMPUTER
  1. Copy ipabazooka.exe to the other PC (USB stick, OneDrive, email, etc.)
     — or copy the zip file and unzip it there.
  2. Double-click ipabazooka.exe to start it. You can drag it to the Desktop
     or pin it to the taskbar if you like.
  3. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click "More info", then
     "Run anyway". This appears for apps that aren't from the Microsoft Store
     or a paid code-signing certificate.

THE OTHER PC ALSO NEEDS (same as Sideloadly)
  * The WEB versions of iTunes and iCloud for Windows, from apple.com
    (not the Microsoft Store versions — uninstall those first):
      - iTunes: lets the app see your iPhone over USB.
      - iCloud: lets the app make Apple's sign-in data on that PC, which is
        what makes Apple ID sign-in work reliably.
  * Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit).

FIRST RUN ON THE NEW PC
  * Plug in the iPhone with a cable, unlock it and tap "Trust".
  * Your theme choice and logs are kept per PC in %APPDATA%\ipabazooka
    (paste that into the File Explorer address bar to open it).
  * The first install on a new PC may ask you to pick an old signing
    certificate to revoke — that's normal for free Apple IDs.

KEYS
  Alt+S   Start (when an app and a device are chosen)
  Alt+.   Show or hide the status history (the full log)
  Alt+V   Show or hide Advanced options
  F11     Full screen (Esc leaves it)

THEMES
  Pick one from the "Theme" menu in the top-right corner:
  Hacker, Normal, Black & White, White on Black, Pink, Midnight, Sunset,
  Ocean, Catppuccin Mocha, Catppuccin Latte, Nord, Everforest,
  Solarized Dark, Solarized Light, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox,
  Rosé Pine, One Dark, Monokai, Synthwave, Lava and Aurora.
